_about: Ballpark facts checked for Reckon. A fact must be checked before its first appearance in Reckon: node tools/build-reckon-batch.js --facts FROM THROUGH lists them; fixes go into Ballpark with tools/apply-ballpark-fixes.js, exclusions into EXCLUDE in tools/build-reckon-batch.js. 20 Oct 2026: a random 100 plus every fact in 26 Oct to 25 Nov 2026, then (when Reckon 1 moved to 20 Oct) every fact newly in 20 Oct to 25 Nov 2026, mostly judged from search-result titles and the checkers’ own knowledge (the search tool returned no snippets). 1 Nov 2026 (scheduled check): every fact first in 26 Nov to 25 Dec 2026 not already here, plus those that restamping newly brought into 2 Nov to 25 Dec (WebSearch titles plus knowledge).
